name: Acetic Anhydride
description: A colorless liquid with a strong, pungent odor, commonly used in the production of photographic film and cigarette filters. Its availability is restricted due to its potential for criminal misuse, particularly in the production of gray heroin.

name: Ammonium Chloride
description: An inorganic compound commonly used as a fertilizer for crops such as rice and wheat. Prolonged application can increase soil acidity, so it should be used with caution. It can also be used in the extraction of morphine from opium.

name: Analog Indicator
description: An analog gauge used to display measured values. Currently, it sits at zero. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Bromopyridine
description: A halogenated pyridine compound commonly used as a chemical intermediate in the synthesis of more complex organic substances. Suitable for use in the production of stimulants.

name: Circuit Board
description: A versatile circuit board with multiple inputs and outputs, as well as microprocessor for basic programming. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Citric Acid
description: An eco-friendly alternative to harsher cleaning chemicals, citric acid is effective at removing mineral buildup, grease, and everyday grime. Its acidic properties also make it useful in the production of morphine solution.

name: Complex Glass Electrode
description: An engineered glass electrode designed to measure ionic activity in liquids. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Empty Autoinjector
description: An empty autoinjector that can be filled with a variety of medical substances for quick and simple administration. Required for crafting most stimulants

name: Fabrics
description: A roll of durable cloth fabric suitable for insulation, filtration, padding and other practical uses. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Garden Lime
description: A granular soil conditioner. Its acid-neutralizing properties allow beneficial bacteria to flourish, improving the growth and resilience of crops. It can also be used in the morphine extraction process. Keep out of reach of children.

name: Gray Heroin
description: A highly addictive opioid substance of relatively low purity. Valuable to those with few morals and the right connections on the black market.

name: Iron Sucrose
description: An iron complex used to replenish the body's iron stores and support the production of hemoglobin and red blood cells. Suitable for use in the production of stimulants.

name: Mechanical Pipette
description: A mechanical pipette that makes laboratory work faster, safer, and more precise. No more sucking chemicals into a glass pipette by mouth. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Multi-Bus Converter
description: An industrial-grade serial communication adapter designed to bridge different hardware communication protocols. An essential for constructing a basic hacking tool.

name: Multimeter
description: A versatile diagnostic tool used to measure voltage, current, and resistance when testing and troubleshooting electrical circuits. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Opium Gum
description: A sticky, gum-like substance collected by scoring poppy seedpods. An essential raw material for opiate production.

name: Phon Chai Farm Shed Key
description: A key to storage shed at Phon Chai Farm.

name: Purified Water
description: Water purified through boiling and condensation to remove impurities. Not intended for consumption, but ideal for use in opiate production.

name: Saline
description: A sterile saline solution with a variety of laboratory and medical applications, including wound cleaning, nasal rinsing, and contamination control. It also serves as a suitable base for morphine solutions.

name: Signal Generator
description: A device capable of accurately generating a wide range of electrical signal waveforms. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Silicone Sealant
description: An aquarium-grade silicone sealant resistant to water and a wide range of chemicals. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.

name: Theophylline
description: A methylxanthine compound with stimulant and bronchodilatory properties, capable of increasing central nervous system activity while relaxing smooth muscle in the airways. Suitable for use in the production of stimulants.

name: Water Pump
description: A small powered device designed to move liquids from one place to another. Useful for building and upgrading Hideout stations.
